sorting_visualizer.name: Sorting Visualizer
sorting_visualizer.description: Visualize sorting algorithms with rainbow gradient bars. Includes Bubble Sort, Quick Sort, and Merge Sort with speed controls and frame saving.
sorting_visualizer.author: Loops System

sorting_lightning.name: ⚡ Sorting Lightning
sorting_lightning.description: Advanced sorting visualization with lightning effects, particle systems, smooth animations, and multiple visual themes. Features electric arcs, glowing effects, and cinematic visuals.
sorting_lightning.author: AI Assistant

neon_van_gogh.name: The Neon Van Gogh Field
neon_van_gogh.description: Thousands of glowing, short line segments trace swirling paths over a dark canvas.
neon_van_gogh.author: AI Assistant

galton_board.name: The Galton Board Drop
galton_board.description: Thousands of tiny balls drop through a pegboard pyramid, settling into a perfect Bell Curve.
galton_board.author: AI Assistant

geometry_sorter.name: 🔷 Geometry Sorter
geometry_sorter.description: A stream of mixed shapes falls onto a sorting slide. Only correct shapes pass through corresponding holes - squares through square holes, circles through circular holes. Features satisfying physics-based sorting with pymunk.
geometry_sorter.author: AI Assistant
